content.introduction: The sources indicate recent developments in technology, including AI computing startup Lambda raising $4B ahead of its planned IPO, and Anthropic offering startups a free year of its Claude Team and $1,000 in credits. CNBC reports on Robinhood's weekend trading hours and AI agents, Trump's unsettled AI safety meeting, and a lawsuit against OpenAI. TechNewsWorld highlights advancements in AI, robotics, and virtual reality, and mentions malware threats and stolen browser cookies. TechCrunch covers AI computing, transportation, and social media trends, including Flai’s AI dealership software and Uber’s $2.3B catering venture.
